verdict.rationale: Drata publishes a documented Public APIv2 with a broad OpenAPI-based reference covering Personnel, Devices, Controls, Policies, Risks, Audits, Monitoring Tests and Custom Connections, including write operations like Create Policy and Create Custom Connection. OAuth setup is also documented, so the product can be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage, and a raw OpenAPI spec file reachable at standard paths (the probes returned 404, though the reference docs exist).
